decisions.winner: Keep native HTML select and option elements.
decisions.rationale: The shared Select is a forwardRef native select and the category page already relies on its value and onChange contract.

decisions.winner: Keep the existing category sort dimensions.
decisions.rationale: The current storefront stylesheet already defines these values.

decisions.candidate: System blue in supplied current screenshot; Atelier wine in proposed design
decisions.winner: Use Atelier wine only in browsers supporting customizable native select.
decisions.rationale: Keep the current browser-native fallback where the picker cannot be styled.

decisions.property: option row height and picker corners
decisions.candidate: No production source value; 44px rows and 10px picker radius proposed
decisions.rationale: Use a touch-friendly target and repeat the established category control corner.
